imagery.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
imagery.metadataSampling: Each tile center and each tile corner, deduplicated. Source footprints may vary inside a tile; sampled metadata is not a pixel-by-pixel provenance raster.
imagery.use: Imagery is streamed from Esri in the public map; analysis image files are not redistributed in the public site.

credits.annotations: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra via Codex app-server, using the user’s ChatGPT/Codex subscription
credits.review: Visual screening annotations. No independent expert validation or burn-event ground truth.

methods.geometry: Model polygons in tile-local pixel-edge coordinates are converted through the Web Mercator tile grid to WGS84 longitude/latitude. OBBs are minimum-area rectangles computed in the original projected pixel plane, not directly in degrees. Their corners are then converted to longitude/latitude.
methods.tiling: A contiguous 3 × 3 grid of 1024 × 1024 analysis images. Each combines 4 × 4 Esri 256-pixel tiles at zoom 18 without resampling. No geographic location is inferred by the model.
methods.counting: Counts are labeled regions or tile fragments, not deduplicated physical objects or whole fields. Adjacent tile-edge instances may describe the same field or kiln.
methods.burning: Burned-looking and partially burned-looking denote RGB appearance only. Unburned-looking means no visible burn evidence in this image, not never burned. Dark soil, moisture, shadow, ploughing, and residue can be confounders. No event dates, burned-area fractions, air pollution, causality, or fire severity are inferred.
methods.masks: Raster masks are pixel-center even–odd polygon fills, including holes, without antialiasing. Coverage is the union of accepted masks inside each non-overlapping tile, not accuracy.
methods.dates: Wayback release date and acquisition dates are different. Capture date comes from Esri metadata, sampled at tile centers and corners, with intersecting metadata source footprints also retained.
methods.validation: Only geometrically valid regions are exported. Any rejected model regions remain identified in the run record and flag the tile for review. Failed and superseded attempts are reported separately; accepted-run token totals exclude them. All recorded usage also includes those attempts, deduplicated by run ID. Attempts without usage cannot be included in measured totals.
methods.scope: Buildings and trees may be grouped; many small features and ambiguous surfaces remain unmapped. Geometry checks establish valid shapes, not visual correctness. Coordinates have imagery and labeling uncertainty, not survey-grade accuracy.
